regime.label: Short-gamma drift into a put-rich Protection build, 82 DTE
evidence: Cumulative net GEX turns positive only above the 1100 gamma flip; spot at 1040.4 sits 60 points below it, so dealers are net short gamma into the current price zone.
Put OI (12,370) exceeds call OI (10,133) for a 1.22 P/C OI ratio, up from 1.08 five sessions ago as downside-protection demand outbuilt call OI (+48.1% vs +31.4%).
ATM IV rose 1.24 points to 15.03% alongside today's -17.2 point drop, confirming live hedging flow rather than a stale move.
Max pain has held at 1040 for 5 straight sessions and spot closed today essentially on top of it after round-tripping a rally to 1065.5 on 07-03.

S50U26.today_summary: S50U26 closed 1040.4, down 17.2 points (-1.63%, about 1.75x the 9.85-point 1-sigma daily move) after round-tripping a 07-03 rally to 1065.5. Put OI (12,370) outweighs call OI (10,133) for a 1.22 put/call OI ratio, while today's volume actually skews call-heavy (2,233 vs 1,952 puts, 0.87 P/C vol ratio). ATM IV rose 1.24 points to 15.03% on the drop, and max pain held at 1040 - exactly where spot landed. The live call wall at 1080 (1,853 OI, 386 volume) sits 40 points above spot; the nearest active put support is 1000 (785 OI, 196 volume), well inside the structural 910 put wall (3,599 OI, no volume today).
what_changed: Future fell 17.2 points (-1.63%) to 1040.4, erasing the entire +15.9 point rally from 07-02 to 07-03 (1049.6 to 1065.5) and landing directly on the unchanged 1040 max pain.
ATM IV jumped from 13.79% to 15.03% (+1.24 points) alongside the drop - IV expanding with price, consistent with genuine hedging demand rather than a stale read.
Put OI grew 48.1% over 5 sessions (8,352 to 12,370) versus call OI's 31.4% (7,709 to 10,133), pushing the P/C OI ratio from 1.08 to 1.22.
The gamma flip moved up to about 1100 as OI concentrated at 1080; spot (1040.4) now sits 60 points below the flip, placing it in short-gamma territory for the first time in the 5-day window.
S50U26.five_day_thesis: Over the past 5 sessions the S50U26 future traced a round trip - 1049.6 (07-02) up to 1065.5 (07-03) then back down to 1040.4 today - while max pain never moved off 1040, reinforcing it as a magnet rather than a coincidence. Total OI grew sharply (calls +31.4%, puts +48.1%), concentrating most heavily at 1080 (now the dominant call wall, 1,853 OI), confirming this is a genuinely young, still-building back-quarter series rather than a stale one. The put/call OI ratio drifted from 1.08 to 1.22 as downside-protection demand outpaced call building, and 25-delta skew now reads +2.85 points put-rich. Cumulative net GEX crossed from negative to positive around 1100, a level spot now sits 60 points below - a shift toward short-gamma exposure near the current price versus the more balanced posture at the start of the window. Today's -17.2 point drop with IV expanding +1.24 points is the first clean confirmation this week that hedging flow, not noise, is pulling price back toward the 1040 anchor.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1030P / 990P
strategies.rationale: Protection-zone build (put OI +48.1% in 5 sessions, put-rich skew +2.85) plus a fresh short-gamma reading below the 1100 flip argue for cheap defined-risk downside insurance rather than fading today's move.
strategies.defined_risk: Net debit ~11.6 points (25.2 - 13.6) = max loss 11.6 points (2,320 baht/contract); max gain = 40-point width - debit = 28.4 points if S50U26 settles at or below 990.
strategies.invalidation: A daily close back above 1060 - reclaiming the level just under the live 1080 call wall - would negate the near-term bearish-hedge thesis.

strategies.name: Call credit spread 1080C / 1100C
strategies.rationale: The 1080 strike is a Vol2Vol-confirmed live wall (1,853 OI, 386 volume today) sitting 40 points above spot; selling into it finances part of the put-side hedge while resistance holds.
strategies.defined_risk: Net credit ~6.0 points (12.5 - 6.5) = max loss 20-point width - credit = 14.0 points (2,800 baht/contract) if S50U26 closes above 1100.
strategies.invalidation: A close above 1080 on rising volume (a live, Vol2Vol-confirmed breakout) would flip this into a squeeze setup - do not fade a confirmed break; close the spread instead.

S50U26.prediction: Bias is neutral-to-cautiously-bearish while max pain sits fixed at 1040 for a 5th straight session and spot (1040.4) has round-tripped the entire 07-03 rally (1065.5) back onto that anchor with ATM IV rising 1.24 points to 15.03% on the drop - a sign of real flow, not noise. A break and hold below the 1000 near-put-wall (785 OI, 196 volume today) opens a path toward the 970 25-delta put band; reclaiming 1060, just under the live 1080 call wall, would invalidate the near-term bearish lean. At 82 DTE this remains an early-cycle read - treat directional conviction as low until near-money OI concentrates further.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice. SET50 options are cash-settled on the index with no physical delivery, so any pull toward max pain (1040) is a tendency, not a guarantee, and pinning mechanics here are structurally weaker than for physically-settled single stocks. This series is 82 days from expiry with OI still building, so directional conviction should stay low, and defined-risk structures still carry their full stated max loss.
